subject: sessionctx: set strict assertion level as default for next-gen (#63174)
summary: Changes @@tidb_txn_assertion_level compiled-in default to STRICT for next-gen builds (classic remains OFF), and adjusts global bootstrap/default handling so classic new installs keep FAST while next-gen inherits STRICT. Reviewed the sysvar wiring and bootstrap/call sites in sessionctx; no remaining Blocker/High correctness/compatibility/session-behavior issues found relative to first parent (and later upstream history does not reveal an unfixed high-severity regression from this change).
